name: Rosalie
source:
Rosalie, born as a commoner, has become the popular 'saintess' and beloved idol of the public because of her soft personality. Even though she took Lucena's place, she secretly idolises Lucena. Now, she's only a budding spring flower in the court of Iriyn, but time will reveal her potential.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541340/Your_Crown_Is_Mine/]Steam[/url]]
